notlar: EXPLORER TREE: the Explorer now lists an archive as a tree - archive, type, class, entry and the files inside each entry - with a Type column, type chips and instant search over every row; click an inner file to open it as XML. LENGTH-CHANGING RAW EDITS: a .bin you exported from the Explorer or with Unpack all can be put back even when its size changed; Workshop rewrites the inner file's own size field, appends the new bytes and redirects the table of contents, so the original is never overwritten and Revert restores it. A file whose wrapper header is damaged is refused before anything is written. Also fixed: the README header still showed an old version; Restore All left hidden parts, ship stats, XML edits and imported meshes in place - it now reverts every record Workshop wrote and says what it could not.
